questions.query: Why are _language_for, _parser_for and _compiled_query in ingestion_service/src/core/extractors/treesitter/base.py cached, and what is rebuilt without those caches?
questions.rubric: Reuse Language/Parser per suffix and Query per language/source; removing caches reconstructs them on repeated calls.

questions.query: In compute_partial_evidence_survival, which drop_reason wins when a graph-only target is capped out and also never fetched?
questions.rubric: truncated_by_max_expanded_docs; the cap branch precedes fetch-empty in the elif chain.

questions.query: After hybrid_retrieve finds seed canonical IDs, what steps select the expanded documents to fetch, and where can list position discard evidence?
questions.rubric: Rank graph candidates; map canonical IDs to documents; deduplicate and exclude seed documents; slice at MAX_EXPANDED_DOCS before fetching.

questions.query: When GraphAssembler._link_docs_to_code finds an ambiguous Markdown heading matching multiple code symbols, which canonical ID wins and where is that rule implemented?
questions.rubric: SymbolTable.lookup returns the lexicographically smallest canonical ID. The assembler calls it for heading then lowercase heading.

questions.query: What matching strategy does GraphAssembler._link_docs_to_code use to create DOCUMENTS edges? Does it use an LLM or fuzzy similarity?
questions.rubric: Exact heading name through symbol table, lowercase fallback, deterministic doc-to-code DOCUMENTS edge; no LLM or fuzzy matching.

questions.query: What are the defaults for MAX_EXPANDED_DOCS, EXPANDED_DOC_CHUNKS, MAX_TOTAL_CHUNKS and MAX_CONCURRENT_DOC_FETCHES in rag_orchestrator/src/core/config.py?
questions.rubric: 20, 3, 50, 8 respectively; these are defaults and environment may override them.

questions.query: In execute_traversals_from_seeds_detailed, how are candidates ordered after equal strategy priority and seed-hit counts, and why can that disadvantage late alphabetical IDs under a cap?
questions.rubric: Ascending canonical ID breaks ties after strategy index then descending seed hits; late IDs may fall beyond MAX_EXPANDED_DOCS despite equal structural rank.

questions.query: What two truncation steps does shared/embedders/ollama.py _truncate apply before embedding, in what order and with what default limits?
questions.rubric: First take the first 800 characters if needed, then limit the resulting text to 400 whitespace-separated words if needed.
